description: This file contains unit tests for the LeaveRequestCommentAPI class in the OrangeHRM HR management system. It tests functionalities such as creating, retrieving, and listing leave request comments via the API, ensuring proper interactions with service and DAO layers, and validating input rules.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentAPITest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the LeaveRequestCommentAPI endpoints related to leave request comments.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Verifies that the API returns an instance of LeaveRequestCommentService.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a leave request comment, including DAO interactions and response normalization.

methods.name: testCreateLeaveRequestRecordNotFound
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to create a comment on a non-existent leave request results in a not found exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks validation rules for creating a comment.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all comments for a specific leave request, verifying proper data mapping.

methods.name: testGetAllLeaveRequestRecordNotFound
methods.description: Verifies behavior when retrieving comments for a non-existent leave request.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Tests validation rules for retrieving all comments.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the delete endpoint is not implemented and throws the expected exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the validation rule for delete throws the expected not implemented exception.
